verdict.rationale: Muse is built around natural-language chat. The homepage says to "just tell Muse what you want to get done" in the mobile app, on Mac, or in WhatsApp, with no learning curve. Goals and tasks can also be managed by talking to it in chat, and side chats keep separate contexts. App Store reviews and an HN comment describe users getting tasks done this way easily. Missing for 10: independent hands-on testing of how reliably natural-language commands turn into the intended actions.
